description: SQL-CONTINUE, missing variant: skip-and-continue for a locked candidate that is on a different page than the others, with dbFailOnError. Big has 65,536 rows (V = 0) over hundreds of pages. For the blocked row ID 0 (first), 30000 (middle) and 65535 (last): V is reset to 0, a second Workspace holds a pessimistic Edit on that row through a dynaset, UPDATE Big SET V = V + 1 runs with dbFailOnError (return, RecordsAffected, Errors), then Count(*) with Sum(V) and the ids of the rows left at V = 0 (up to 64) show which rows the statement changed. Follow-up probe (round 2) for SQL-CONTINUE; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-big through DAO.DBEngine.120. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
